user_query: I'm organizing a game night for my family and we need some dice for our board games. Can you roll a 6-sided die once and apply a modifier of 5 to the result. Also, fetch a random taboo word from any category to add an element of surprise to our games.

TaskList.description: Roll a 6-sided die once to generate a random number between 1 and 6.
Apply a modifier of 5 to the die roll result to get the final number.
Fetch a random taboo word from any category to add an element of surprise.
